bonus_reports.note: AP (ESPN.com, 1999-12-21) says Beltré received a $17,000 signing bonus when he signed. SABR gives $23,000; the disagreement is unresolved and no canonical bonus is set.
SABR's Beltré biography says the Dodgers signed him for $23,000 on July 7, 1994. The AP report of Selig's 1999 ruling gives $17,000; the two disagree, so no canonical bonus is set.
